task: 顶部云带重画（不规则云岸）
base_prompt:
A single game UI strip for an all-ages mobile casual game, in EXACTLY the soft hand-painted cloud style of the top-left and top-right clouds of the third attached image (pure white puffs with soft pale-blue shading, gentle cel shading, no outlines). Strictly original; no text, no characters, no icons, no castle, no rainbow.

ONE wide horizontal CLOUD BANK, 1080x80 pixels, transparent background (PNG with alpha). It hangs across the top of a game board as a soft ceiling; rows of small bubbles appear from under it. It sits on a clean deep clear-day blue sky (about #3578DA).

Shape, from left to right:
- Left 15% and right 15%: fuller, rounder cloud puffs of different sizes, rising up to the top of the image.
- Middle 70%: a THIN, LOW, calm cloud edge, only about 22 to 34 px tall measured from the bottom, gently undulating with a few puffs of clearly different sizes; it must NOT look like a uniform row of identical bumps, a rope, a braid or a chain.
- Puff sizes and spacing vary naturally; no visible repetition.
- The bottom edge is a soft, slightly wavy cloud underside that runs the FULL width without gaps.

Look: calm, soft, low contrast between light and shade; no bright specular highlights, no sparkles, no hard dark outlines, no gray, no colored tints other than pale blue shading.

attempts.prompt:
Edit the SECOND input image, using ONLY the white/pale-blue cloud painting in the upper corners of the FIRST image as the style reference. Deliver just the transparent cloud strip, no scenery, sky, UI or text.

The second image is a near-miss cloud asset. KEEP its calm blue-white painted material and narrow central strip, but FIX its silhouette and repetitive details:
1. Break the symmetry. The far LEFT edge has one fuller high fluffy mound around x=4%, followed by one smaller subordinate puff; it descends quickly and is low by x=13%. The far RIGHT has a lower small puff around x=91% and its tallest mound right at x=99%, a clearly different silhouette.
2. Redraw the entire middle 70% as one calm continuous LOW CLOUD SHELF with ONLY THREE extremely shallow broad irregular rises. Approximate positions and widths: a small narrow rise near x=25%, a long very flat rise spanning x=36%-59%, then a medium rise near x=73%. Their shapes, heights and gaps MUST be different. Long nearly flat stretches of thin white cloud connect them. Eliminate the row of bead-like round bumps, little balls, scalloped cylinders, repetitions and rhythmic lighting.
3. In the middle, remove all repeated inner puff circles/highlight blobs. Paint it almost as a single quiet white mass with a subtle diffuse pale blue underside, just a little soft volume under the three unequal shallow rises. No spot highlights, no shiny gel, no texture or speckles, no gray.
4. Never make the center a rope or sausage: its upper contour has broad calm slopes, and its lower edge is a mostly straight soft continuous underside with only tiny changes. NO repeated semi-circles on the bottom. The white cloud must remain continuous edge to edge including extreme left/right edges; no holes.

Target export geometry: 1080x80 RGBA, extremely wide and shallow. Middle x=162..917 has top y=46..58; every pixel above y=46 there is alpha 0. All x across rows y=60..64 are fully opaque cloud. Cloud fades only below that, y=65..79. Ends can reach the top. If output canvas is larger, keep the artwork's wide shallow proportions with only transparent padding. Do not draw any stray translucent particles above or below the cloud: outside the cloud is perfectly empty transparent alpha.
This is a quiet cloud bank at the top of a mobile bubble game, NOT a decorative wavy border. Preserve fluffy round cloud shapes at the far ends and keep the thin middle deliberately understated.
attempts.verdict: 形状与遮挡通过；底缘蓝色阴影偏重，由第4次减淡。
